story_type: injured fisherman rides a rescue basket up from a boat running through the Gulf, hoist cam
hook: Hurt on a fishing boat, 65 miles out in the Gulf.
narration: This fisherman was riding a steel basket up from his boat, sixty-five miles out.
He had been injured while fishing, far off the Florida coast.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk crew from Air Station Clearwater lowered the basket to the boat's deck.
The basket is the simplest way up. The person climbs in, sits down and holds on.
The flight mechanic guided it up, swinging over the boat's white wake.
outcome: And the crew flew him to Regional Medical Center Bayonet Point in Hudson.
title: Basket ride 65 miles off Florida
description:
On Sept. 23, 2016, a Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater MH-60 Jayhawk crew hoisted an injured fisherman from a boat 65 miles west of Hudson, Florida, and flew him to Regional Medical Center Bayonet Point.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Clearwater, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/484644/coast-guard-medevacs-diver-65-miles-west-hudson-fla
